notes:
Original locator p. 3 differs from the Experiment 1 composite result on PDF p. 2 (journal p. 1220). Study, manipulation and outcome identify the Experiment 1 test. Original reports p_rep = .90, not a conventional p value; p left null without conversion. Original cached text has OCR substitutions in statistical symbols; the printed partial eta-squared is .09. Replication title and author match the supplied reference; full manuscript obtained from the supplied Google Drive file. Replication results on PDF p. 5 match the locator. Replication authors report failure of the confirmatory replication, with exploratory age-subgroup findings discussed separately.
